The source says short RNA distributes randomly in amounts related to daughter volume. Volume-related partition is not a demonstrated accurate nonrandom genome segregation mechanism or persistent inheritance over replenished generations.

contexts.observable: Fluorescent RNA-bearing vesicle counts and filtrate fluorescence, with reference controls.

The selected result is Figure 3A-D oleate, not the separate decanoate mixture.
